I swapped Triceps Pushdown for Lateral Raise in today's workout only. Your routine is unchanged. 💪 Lateral raises put very little load on the elbow. The other triceps options, dips and overhead extensions, are harder on it.

Keep the weight light and stop if the elbow hurts. Pressing movements like bench and overhead press may also bother it, so drop the weight if they do. If the pain is sharp or lasts, stop and get it checked by a professional. ⚠️
